# Auditools

> Auditools is a free suite of AI-powered readiness audits: Etsy listings, KDP books, product mockups, newsletters, course pages, freelancer profiles, and Airbnb listings.

Canonical host: https://auditools.aiyes.space

## Core pages

- [Home](https://auditools.aiyes.space/)

## Audit suite

- [Listora](https://listora.aiyes.space/) — Etsy listing SEO audit and tag optimization.
- [BookListing AI](https://booklisting.aiyes.space/) — KDP book listing SEO audit.
- [Mockly](https://mockly.aiyes.space/) — e-commerce / POD product mockup and listing-image audit.
- [Newsletterly](https://newsletterly.aiyes.space/) — newsletter growth-readiness audit.
- [Launchly](https://launchly.aiyes.space/) — course / digital-product sales-page conversion audit.
- [Profilo](https://profilo.aiyes.space/) — freelancer profile-readiness audit.
- [Stayly](https://stayly.aiyes.space/) — Airbnb listing audit for hosts.
